s: July 30, 2024 - And what if you are looking to purchase a home that already has a solar PV system installed? So, if you are considering installing solar but may sell your home in the near future, solar is still likely to increase your bottom line. Similarly, if you are a home buyer, buying a house with solar panels allows you to tap into the benefits of solar as soon as you move in.
